newsitem.title: FRANCE: Arafat to attend World Bank donors' meeting.
newsitem.headline: Arafat to attend World Bank donors' meeting.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat will attend a donors' meeting in Paris of the World Bank's Consultative Group on the West Bank and Gaza on Wednesday, the Bank said on Monday.
The meeting is a pledging session for World Bank programmes in the autonomous Palestinian areas for 1997, Kemal Dervis, World Bank vice-president for the Middle East and North Africa, told reporters.
Arafat will be accompanied by Nabil Shaath and Mohammed Nashashibi who are among his main advisers for economic and financial issues.
Arafat will hold a news conference on Wednesday at 5.30 p.m. (1630 GMT) after the donors' meeting which some 40 countries and international institutions are expected to attend.

The economic situation in the West Bank and Gaza has worsened following the closure imposed on the areas by Israel in February after a wave of bomb attacks by Moslem fundamentalists killed dozens of people in Israel.
The World Bank said the political situation had resulted in projections of a decline of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) of five percent for 1996 in the autonomous Palestinian areas.
